_about: Company leave policy: the leave types, their entitlements, any shared pools, and the two system types the application looks up by code. This is an EXAMPLE. Copy it to seed/company-policy.json (gitignored, never packaged), edit it to your company's policy, and apply it with `python -m scripts.seed_company_policy --confirm`. Nothing here is applied automatically: a deployment never ships somebody else's policy, and an empty Leave types screen is the correct state for a fresh production database.

pools.name: Sick + Casual Leave
pools.note: Sick and Casual draw on one entitlement of 9 days: 2 days of Sick leaves 7 for either.

system_leave_types.name: Loss of Pay
system_leave_types.note: Loss of Pay. The automatic conversion of an unwithdrawn rejected advance leave posts to this type; without it that sweep does nothing.

system_leave_types.name: Compensatory Off
system_leave_types.note: Compensatory Off. The comp-off claim workflow credits this type; without it claims are refused with a configuration message.
